title: Hotuba ya Kushawishi (Theme 12: Magonjwa yanayotokana na mienendo ya maisha)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the features of a persuasive speech: itifaki, a clear stand, reasons with facts and examples, a call to act, and thanks.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the parts of a speech.
floor.question: Hotuba huanza na?

board.do: Wenzangu, tuchague maji badala ya soda kwa sababu...
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels the features and adds one fact to a weak point.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Hotuba ya kushawishi hulenga nini?" Kwa nini "kuburudisha tu" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Hotuba huanza kwa nini?" Kwa nini "wito" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Hotuba huanza kwa salamu na utangulizi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Hotuba ya kushawishi hutumia nini kuunga wazo?" Kwa nini "hoja na mifano" si jibu sahihi?

listen_for: Vyakula hivi ni vibaya sana sana!
misconceptions.ask: Ushahidi wa hoja yako ni upi?
misconceptions.repair: Hotuba ya kushawishi hutumia ukweli na mifano, si hisia tu.

checks.question: Hotuba ya kushawishi humalizika vipi?
checks.answer: kwa wito wa kuchukua hatua na shukrani

skills.key_step: The child plans hotuba before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Tuepuke Vyakula Visivyo na Afya".

listen_for: moja kwa moja na hoja ya kwanza

misconceptions.repair: Hotuba huzungumza na hadhira moja kwa moja.
Funga hotuba kwa muhtasari na shukrani.
Hotuba ya kupasha habari hutoa ukweli muhimu.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba kuhusu "Tuepuke Vyakula Visivyo na Afya"?
Hotuba ina sehemu zipi?
checks.answer: itifaki, utangulizi, kiini, hitimisho na shukrani
